note: SNG-263 catalog pass, traditions 13 AND 14 of 27 — SOMATIC and COGITANT, the body/mind axis, 6th antipode pair. THIS PAIR IS UNIQUE: it contains the catalog's ONLY craft that requires BOTH POLES — somatic's the_whole_act (T-IV), whose HARD bound is 'needs both trained near-equal; THE PURE POLES CANNOT DO IT.' passFindings: ⚠️ THE CATALOG'S ONLY DUAL-POLE CRAFT, and the strongest argument for Erik's FOOTHILLS ask: somatic's the_whole_act (T-IV) has as its ONLY bound — 'NEEDS BOTH TRAINED NEAR-EQUAL; THE PURE POLES CANNOT DO IT.' Every other axis walls its poles apart; this one authors a craft that EXISTS ONLY IN THE MIDDLE. The middle of an axis is a real, authored place. CCODE: the engine has no concept of a craft gated on TWO traditions being near-equal. Added to the checks list.

AN EIGHTH DEFENSIVE LOGIC — EFFICIENT: perfect_motion is not armour (soak 0), not absence, not misdirection; it is never making a wasted or wrong motion. It uses Erik's evasion model cleanly. Eight logics now, all riding one guard shape: BLUNT / ANCHOR / EVADE / RUN-WITHOUT-YOU / NEVER-FOUND / MISDIRECTED / TYPED-IMMUNITY / EFFICIENT.

A SECOND TYPED GUARD confirms item 6d is a real pattern, not a one-off: the_unmoving_mind soaks FEAR, DECEPTION and DISRUPTION at rank 3 and grants NOTHING against physical harm ('it grants no offense, only the unshakeable read'), exactly as the_true_ground soaks deception and nothing against a blade. TWO traditions independently authored typed defence.

SIX TRADITIONS NOW REFUSE COERCION MECHANICALLY, and the cogitant states it most plainly: the_necessary_case r3 — 'NOT BECAUSE YOU COMMANDED THEM, but because they can all see it.' With harmonic_voice, steady_soul, the_weight_of_practice, the_weight_of_truth and the_weight_of_presence ('people ACCOUNT FOR you, they do not OBEY you'). Six traditions, none referencing each other, all agreeing influence is earned or shown — never imposed. This is now the most robust cross-tradition value in the catalog.

THREE MEMORY-RECOVERY CRAFTS ACROSS THREE TRADITIONS, all carrying the same bound: memory_palace ('what you store you keep, INCLUDING WHAT YOU WOULD RATHER HAVE LOST'), harmonic's echo_memory ('what the deep stacks answer, YOU CANNOT UNHEAR'), ashwarden's ask_the_dead ('you will hear things that were not yours to know, AND YOU CANNOT GIVE THEM BACK'). A thematic constant nobody coordinated.

MATCHED T-I CRAFTS, OPPOSITE BLINDNESS: second_wind borrows from the BODY'S TOMORROW; total_focus borrows by NOT NOTICING THE BODY AT ALL ('people have been focused to death'). Same function — push past your limit — and each is dangerous in precisely the way the OTHER tradition would have caught. The axis is authored as a mutual correction, not a rivalry.

skydancer's 'THERE IS NO HOVER AT ANY MASTERY' joins wither's 'living flesh is outside it AT EVERY RANK' — the second time an author has pre-empted the mastery question IN THE TEXT ITSELF. Continued strong evidence that the HARD/SOFT classing recovers authorial intent rather than imposing mine.
gapFillNote: ERIK'S CORRECTION (2026-08-02): 'Don't treat everything as written in stone — you authored all these in the past. Fill in gaps and rebalance if needed. Make the content better through generative lore.' He is right, and the somatic gap was the clearest case in the catalog: the tradition's own withMastery line promises 'the whole mastered frame behind A SINGLE STRIKE' and the catalog had no strike craft. That is PromisedButUnread at the TRADITION level — the same bug class I have been finding all pass, and I walked past it because I was treating the craft list as fixed. TWO CRAFTS ADDED: the_gathered_strike (the promised damage) and the_broken_rhythm (the missing control role, derived from body_read's existing precision). Somatic goes 2/5 roles -> 4/5.
